metadata.title: Clicked like I’m swatting ghosts and somehow snatched 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic broke
metadata.description:
Just mashed buttons like my mouse was possessed.
That 1 kill probably made the enemy question reality.
Did NOT deserve that but hey, I’m cashing in on chaos.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, you’re in good company.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
